sport/basketball.title: Surebets on basketball
sport/basketball.metaTitle: Basketball surebets – guaranteed odds on NBA and Euroleague
sport/basketball.description: Find surebets on basketball from the NBA, Euroleague and European leagues. Points markets and handicaps provide numerous opportunities with Danish bookmakers.
sport/basketball.intro: Basketball offers many surebets on points and handicaps. The NBA has a wide range of markets, and bookmakers move their lines at different speeds.

blocks.text: Popular markets

items: Match winner including overtime: two outcomes and simple calculation.
Over/under total points, e.g. over or under 215.5.
Points handicap, where the favourite must win by a certain number of points.
Player-specific markets such as points, rebounds and assists.

blocks.text: Middling on points

With points markets, two bookmakers may have different lines, e.g. over 214.5 at one and under 216.5 at another. If the match ends on 215 or 216 points, you win both bets. This is called a 'middle' and is an extra bonus with basketball.
Check whether overtime counts. In basketball it almost always does, but not at all bookmakers on all markets.

faq.q: Does overtime count in basketball surebets?
faq.a: For most markets yes, but always check the rules. A market excluding overtime cannot be combined with a market including overtime.

faq.q: When are NBA matches played in Danish time?
faq.a: Most NBA matches are played overnight in Danish time, so many surebets appear in the evening before the matches.

sport/ishockey.title: Ice hockey surebets
sport/ishockey.metaTitle: Ice hockey surebets – guaranteed odds on NHL and Danish leagues
sport/ishockey.description: Ice hockey surebets from NHL, SHL and Danish leagues. Learn the difference between markets with and without overtime, and find guaranteed odds at Danish bookmakers.
sport/ishockey.intro: Ice hockey is an underrated sport for surebets. Many bookmakers price the Nordic leagues differently, and the distinction between markets with and without overtime creates additional opportunities.

blocks.text: Regulation time or including overtime?

In ice hockey, there is both a 1X2 market for regulation time only and a winner market including overtime and shootouts. These two must never be mixed in the same surebet. Always check which market you are betting on with each bookmaker.
Good leagues for surebets

items: NHL: many matches and high maximum stakes.
SHL and Liiga: popular in the Nordic region and priced differently by bookmakers.
Metal Ligaen: Danish league where Danish bookmakers often disagree on pricing.

blocks.text: Ice hockey often offers high profit per surebet, but lower maximum stakes than football.

faq.q: Can you combine 1X2 and winner including overtime?
faq.a: No. These are two different markets. If you combine them, you can lose both bets if the match goes to overtime.

faq.q: Are there surebets on Metal Ligaen?
faq.a: Yes. Danish bookmakers price Metal Ligaen differently, so opportunities arise regularly.

sport/fodbold.title: Surebets on football
sport/fodbold.metaTitle: Football surebets – find guaranteed odds on football matches
sport/fodbold.description: Find surebets on football in real time. BetTrackerAI scans odds on the Danish Superliga, Premier League and hundreds of other leagues at Danish bookmakers.
sport/fodbold.intro: Football is the sport with the most surebets. Matches are played around the clock, and each match has hundreds of markets that bookmakers price differently.

blocks.text: Why football produces many surebets

Bookmakers have to price thousands of football matches every week, from the Champions League to lower divisions. The smaller the league, the less time bookmakers spend on it, and the greater the chance of price discrepancies.
The most commonly used markets

items: 1X2: home win, draw and away win. Three outcomes, so you need three bets.
Over/under goals, e.g. over or under 2.5 goals. Only two outcomes and often high liquidity.
Asian handicap: two outcomes and low margin, but read the rules for half and whole goals carefully.
Both teams to score: yes or no. A simple market with two outcomes.

blocks.text: Always check whether the market applies to normal time only. Extra time and penalties rarely count in football.
When do surebets arise?
Many football surebets arise when team line-ups are announced roughly an hour before kick-off. Some bookmakers adjust quickly, others are slower, and price differences emerge in that window.

faq.q: Which football leagues have the most surebets?
faq.a: Smaller leagues often offer higher profit, but major leagues like the Premier League and Danish Superliga have more markets and higher maximum stakes.

faq.q: Can you bet on surebets on live football?
faq.a: Yes, but live odds change very quickly. It requires you to place both bets within a few seconds.

sport/esport.title: Surebets on esports
sport/esport.metaTitle: Esports surebets – guaranteed odds on CS2, LoL and Dota 2
sport/esport.description: Esports is one of the fastest-growing sports for surebets. Find guaranteed odds on CS2, League of Legends and Dota 2 at Danish bookmakers.
sport/esport.intro: Esports has large price differences between bookmakers. The market is new, many bookmakers have fewer experts in the field, and odds often move significantly before match start.

blocks.text: Why esports yields high profit

Bookmakers dedicate fewer resources to esports than to football, and news about team line-ups spreads quickly within the community. This creates larger odds differences and often higher profit per surebet.
Popular games

items: Counter-Strike 2: most matches and markets for map and round handicaps.
League of Legends: major tournaments with stable markets.
Dota 2: high odds differences, but lower maximum stakes.

blocks.text: Watch out for postponed matches. Bookmakers have different rules for how long a bet remains valid.

faq.q: Are esports good for surebets?
faq.a: Yes, the profit is often higher than in traditional sports. However, the maximum stakes are lower.

faq.q: Which bookmakers offer esports?
faq.a: Most major Danish bookmakers offer esports, especially CS2 and League of Legends.

sport/tennis.title: Surebets on Tennis
sport/tennis.metaTitle: Tennis Surebets – Guaranteed Odds on ATP, WTA and Challenger
sport/tennis.description: Tennis is perfect for surebets: just two outcomes and matches all year round. Find tennis surebets on ATP, WTA and Challenger at Danish bookmakers.
sport/tennis.intro: Tennis is the preferred sport for many sure bettors. There are only two outcomes, no draw, and tournaments take place almost every single day of the year.

blocks.text: The Advantages of Tennis

items: Only two outcomes, so you only need to place two bets.
No draw, which makes the calculation simple.
Plenty of matches at Challenger and ITF level, where bookmakers often disagree.
Matches around the clock due to tournaments in different time zones.

blocks.text: Beware of Retired Matches

The biggest risk in tennis is when a player retires from a match. Bookmakers have different rules: some void the bet, others settle it if the first set has been completed. If your two bookmakers use different rules, you could lose both bets.
Read the bookmakers' rules for retired tennis matches before placing your first tennis surebet.
Other Markets
Besides the match winner, there are surebets on total games, set handicaps and individual set winners. These markets often have lower maximum stakes.

faq.q: Is tennis good for surebets?
faq.a: Yes. Only two outcomes and plenty of matches make tennis one of the best sports for surebets, especially for beginners.

faq.q: What happens if a player retires?
faq.a: It depends on the bookmaker. Some void all bets, others settle them if a certain number of sets have been played. Check the rules at both bookmakers.
